The '''Kalist base commissary''' was the eating establishment located in [[Kalist Base]] on [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]]. The crew of the tanker ''[[Nuna's Twins]]'' was offered a warm meal here after a rebel attack on the base.
